key_claims.claim: Periconceptional GLP-1 receptor agonist exposure is not associated with a statistically significant increase in adverse maternal pregnancy outcomes, though confidence intervals remain wide.
Forty-three antenatal and delivery factors, including pre-pregnancy obesity, are significantly associated with infant cerebral palsy based on pooled meta-analytic evidence.
RCT-level evidence on cerclage for short cervix at or below 20.9 mm before 24 weeks in singletons without prior preterm birth has been synthesized, addressing a clinically debated indication.
FMF combined first-trimester screening for preterm preeclampsia is cost-effective compared to NICE criteria in the UK NHS when aspirin prophylaxis is applied.
In-utero cardiac intervention in selected hydropic fetuses with congenital heart disease may improve survival compared to expectant management.
